title: Forward Deployed Engineer: The Truth About Tech's Hottest Job (I Counted Every Open Role)
summary: Code with Jay defines the forward-deployed engineer role, counts 223 real postings and separates real demand from rebranding.

assertions.quote: about 281 roles worldwide, a real job market of a few hundred seats globally, not a wave ... The work is real. The title is a recruiting instrument. Both.

verdicts.note: Postings data cited (Palantir, Databricks, labs) and LinkedIn growth from a tiny base support 'real but small'; Palantir's own filings describe the work as professional services.

assertions.quote: Forward deployed engineer 42 times growth since 2023

verdicts.note: FDE postings grew several-fold in 2025 as AI labs and startups (OpenAI, Anthropic, Palantir-style firms) hired for them; still a small share of jobs.

assertions.quote: The thing the customer asks you for on day one is usually not the thing that is costing them money

verdicts.note: Consistent with long-standing requirements-engineering and Palantir FDE practice, and with reports that many AI pilots fail from poor workflow fit; anecdotal rather than measured.
